title: gpu dplus shading tonemap port log visibility

commit.merge_subject: merge: gpu dplus shading tonemap port log visibility

description:
Every export now emits one DEBUG stage-log line through the existing
per-export sink (AppNav wires it to Log.i under "ritim-export", DEBUG
builds only; a null sink emits nothing and the encoded bytes are
identical):

  render backend: requested=<X> effective=<Y> unsupported=<tokens or none>

The line makes the requested-vs-effective axis visible per export,
never only on fallback — CPU exports log it too (effective=CPU).

The EFFECTIVE value is the axis the export actually has today: the
encoder-Surface input mode is this pipeline's GPU leg (the per-frame
develop always runs the CPU reference — the fragment develop pass is
not wired into the export), so effective=GLES means the writer took
the Surface mode (writer.surfaceInputActive(), the hook built for
exactly this honest-report purpose, never for a decision) and the
frames feed the encoder through its input Surface; every other shape
changed: feat: lens shading and highlight reconstruction fragment port
feat: tonemap fragment port (aces + agx family)
